verified_facts: INSPIRE index polygons show indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties
dataset is updated on the first Sunday of each month
published files show data from the previous month
current download page states publication date 5 July 2026
files remain accessible until the next update
GIS software is required to view downloaded polygons
downloads are organised by local authority
monthly publication vintage must be attached to geometry evidence
indicative extent must not be treated as determined legal boundary
source provenance must retain HM Land Registry attribution
geometry freshness checks must compare publication month before parcel use
quality_effect: Pins HMLR polygon freshness, format and indicative-only semantics before any geometry can participate in parcel height sampling.
